summary: Validated the FastAPI port of Okume backend against previous Express contracts. Ran 3 existing pytest suites (31 tests total) against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — 30 passed, 1 failed due to STALE TEST expectation (not backend bug). Frontend smoke tested on desktop: home + header search + catalog + admin login + all admin subpages load with 0 network 5XX errors. Root /health returns {ok:true, service:'okume-api'} on backend port; externally it resolves to frontend HTML because k8s ingress only routes /api/* to backend (expected preview infra behavior). Cleanup script executed successfully.

minor.issue: Stale test test_okume_new_features.py::test_admin_campaign_returns_counts asserts status_code==200 but new async campaigns correctly return 202 per new contract. Test file expectation is outdated; actual API behavior matches the review spec (202 + async status poll). Recommend main agent update this test or delete since test_iteration3_features.py::test_admin_campaigns_list_and_send already covers the correct 202+poll flow.

action_items: Update or remove stale test_admin_campaign_returns_counts (expects 200, actual is 202) — the FastAPI implementation correctly matches the async campaign contract; only the outdated pytest assertion needs adjustment.
critical_code_review_comments: FastAPI port of Express backend is contract-faithful: exception handlers emit {"error":"..."} shape (not FastAPI default detail), status codes 201/204/202/401/403/404/409/400 all correctly mapped, ObjectId excluded from responses.

/health (no /api prefix) reachable internally on 8001 but NOT externally — Kubernetes ingress routes non-/api paths to frontend. If k8s liveness probe hits the backend pod directly on 8001 this works; otherwise the review's assertion that external /health returns JSON is incorrect (external returns index.html). Verify k8s probe config in deployment.
Login rate limit noted (12/15min per IP); tests reuse a shared admin token via conftest so no throttling encountered.
test_credentials: admin@okumekaraoke.com / OkumeAdmin2026! — verified working via UI + API
seed_data_creation: None; existing seed used (25 artists, 9 gallery, 88770 songs, settings, 4 real clients preserved). Test data generated by pytest cleaned via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend API contract regression + full frontend smoke passes on the pure-Python FastAPI port. Only outstanding item is stale pytest expectation on campaign endpoint (200 vs 202). Cleanup script works. Resend live — keep campaigns limited to source=importado @example.com clients only.
rca of the issue: test_okume_new_features.py::test_admin_campaign_returns_counts was written when the Express backend responded synchronously (200 + counts). The Python port correctly implements the new async contract (202 + campaign object with status='sending', poll via GET /api/admin/campaigns). Fix: update test to assert 202 and poll until status='done', OR delete test since equivalent coverage exists in test_iteration3_features.py.
